2609.21344.title: CESBench: Benchmarking Large Language Models on Cryptographic Engineering Security for IoT Devices
2609.21344.paper_summary: For Internet of Things (IoT) devices, a secure algorithm alone is not enough: an attacker with physical access can attack the implementation directly, and its flaws are hard to fix once deployed. Large language models (LLMs) are now used to build and analyze such implementations. LLM benchmarks exist for cryptography and general cybersecurity, but none covers cryptographic engineering. In this paper, we present CESBench, 380 expert-written items across six sub-domains of cryptographic engineering security for IoT devices: side-channel, fault injection, implementation, countermeasures, evaluation, and integration. Four task types target different competences: 209 multiple-choice items test recall, 67 judgment items require a security verdict and its justification, 63 scenario items require an engineering diagnosis, and 41 code tasks are graded by 572 test cases. To validate the benchmark, 11 open-weight and proprietary LLMs answer every item. Multiple-choice and code responses are scored automatically, and judgment and scenario responses by an LLM judge, whose scores are checked against a second judge from another model family and human re-scoring. Composite scores range from 54.4% to 83.6%. The top score on each task type is 98.6% for multiple choice, 95.1% for code, and 88.4% for scenario diagnosis, but only 58.8% for judgment. Across models, 88.5% of verdicts are correct, yet their justifications earn only 53.4% of the rubric marks. Multiple choice is near its ceiling for the strongest models and most code tasks are solved, whereas justifying a security verdict remains the weakest competence. The benchmark, prompts, and per-item results are public.
2609.21344.paper_summary_zh: 對於物聯網 (IoT) 設備來說，僅有一個安全的算法是不夠的：擁有物理訪問權的攻擊者可以直接攻擊實現，並且一旦部署後其缺陷很難修復。大型語言模型 (LLMs) 現在被用來構建和分析這樣的實現。存在針對密碼學和一般網絡安全的 LLM 基準，但沒有涵蓋密碼工程的基準。在本文中，我們提出了 CESBench，涵蓋六個子領域的 380 個專家撰寫的物聯網設備密碼工程安全項目：側信道、故障注入、實現、對策、評估和整合。四種任務類型針對不同的能力：209 個選擇題測試回憶，67 個判斷題要求安全裁決及其理由，63 個情境題要求工程診斷，41 個代碼任務由 572 個測試案例進行評分。為了驗證基準，11 個開放權重和專有的 LLM 對每個項目作出回答。選擇題和代碼的回答自動評分，而判斷和情境的回答由 LLM 評審，其分數與來自另一模型家族的第二位評審和人工重新評分進行核對。綜合分數範圍從 54.4% 到 83.6%。每種類型任務的最高分為選擇題 98.6%、代碼 95.1% 和情境診斷 88.4%，但判斷僅為 58.8%。在各模型中，88.5% 的裁決是正確的，但其理由僅獲得 53.4% 的評分標準分數。對於最強的模型，選擇題接近其上限，大多數代碼任務都被解決，而為安全裁決提供理由仍然是最弱的能力。基準、提示和每個項目的結果都是公開的。
